C1249.title: Tongcheng Financial Gift Card Cash-Out Case
C1249.summary: In March 2024, China's CCTV 315 Gala exposed Tongcheng Financial's app for using gift cards to facilitate usurious lending. Consumers purchased high-priced gift cards and then 'recycled' them for cash through the official store at approximately 70% of the original price, effectively constituting illegal lending with interest rates far exceeding national limits.
